mentions.name: Arcitext
mentions.description: Arcitext is an AI-assisted writing platform designed to support rather than replace human creativity. Users create a writing style from existing text examples, blog posts, or URLs, and the platform extracts a "writing fingerprint" that new text is benchmarked against. It offers a Markdown editor with tools such as Tone Fit, Rewrite suggestions, and Fact Check, working like a writing coach and content strategist on demand.
mentions.problem: AI writing tools generate text and try to replace writers; Arcitext instead lends focus to human creativity and assists rather than replaces the writer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've created an AI-assisted writing platform, that doesn't generate text, but instead lends focus to human creativity, and have AI assist you instead of trying to replace you.

https://www.arcitext.com
